message.content:
**Yes – you can file a noise‑complaint with the City of Atlanta.** In the United States, “noise complaints” are usually handled by the city’s police department or code‑enforcement office rather than a separate “council” body. For Atlanta, the process is straightforward: | How to File | What You’ll Need | Where to Go | |-------------|------------------|-------------| | **Online** | • Your name and contact info
• Date, time, and location of the disturbance
• Description of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs)
• Any supporting evidence (photos, videos, audio recordings) | **City of Atlanta’s “Report a Problem” portal** – | | **Phone** | • Same information as above | **311 (or 404‑727‑3111)** – the city’s non‑emergency hotline | | **In‑person** | • Same information | **City Hall (City of Atlanta Police Department)** – 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30309 | | **Mail** | • Same information | **City of Atlanta Police Department** – 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30309 | ### Quick Steps for the Online Portal 1. Visit the City of Atlanta’s 311 portal. 2. Select **“Noise Complaint”** (or “Code Enforcement” → “Noise”). 3. Fill out the form with the required details. 4. Attach any photos or videos if you have them. 5. Submit the form. 6. You’ll receive a confirmation email or text with a reference number. ### Tips & Things to Keep in Mind * **Time of day matters** – most cities have “quiet hours” (often 10 p.m.–7 a.m.). If the noise violates those hours, it’s more likely to be taken seriously. * **Document the disturbance** – timestamps on photos or videos help establish when the noise occurred. * **Follow up** – if you don’t hear back within a few days, call 311 or check the status online using your reference number. * **If it’s an emergency** (e.g., ongoing violent activity), call 911 instead of filing a normal complaint. ### Contact Information | Service | Phone | Email | Address | |---------|-------|-------|---------| | City of Atlanta Police Department (Noise & Code Enforcement) | 404‑727‑3111 (non‑emergency) | *Not publicly listed; use the online portal* | 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30309 | | City of Atlanta 311 | 404‑727‑3111 | *Same as above* | *Same as above* | --- **Bottom line:** Yes, you can report a noise complaint to the City of Atlanta. Use the 311 hotline, the online portal, or visit City Hall. The city’s police department will investigate and enforce the local noise ordinance.
